about_the_game:
Enter the Grind

Cashgrab: Refunded is a roguelite multiplayer title in which hustlers get their money up by pillaging The Grind - a sprawling and esoteric corporate structure home to terrible monsters and grabbas alike. 

Build Your Grabba

Customize your character with our revolutionary face upload system!

#TeamFriends

Everything’s better with your buddies. Navigate treacherous terrain and fight back the local horrors together - or die one by one. When all’s said and done, how’ll you split up the cash? Do your best to make sure negotiations don’t go sideways - or make sure you’re the one who comes out on top.

Spend Money to Make Money

Success isn’t guaranteed. The deeper you go into The Grind the more you stand to gain - and the more likely you are to lose. Use cash to customize your grabba, buy items and ensure you’ve got what you need to get out in the green. As you develop your abilities and your loot pool undertake more daring adventures and watch your money grow.

Economy of Scale

Donate cash to a community pool to make a real difference in the Grabba community and progress story events. Or, if you're selfish, don't. 

Discover the Truth

Big Grabba - The Goblins - The Stock Market - how does it all connect? The truth is obscured, for now. Discover the secret and reap the rewards!

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent depictions of exaggerated gore and violence are present in this game.

short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Use fully physics-based objects and fluid movement to grab some cash and escape The Grind. Use cash to buy items and equipment and fund community goals. Create your Grabba and get rich or die trying.
